decisions.reason: White-label test pressings are a low-cost, limited-run collector niche that fits the established catalog, and a growing industry gives no shortfall against aspirations, though their sporadic nature makes discontinuation more plausible than for a core series.

The German new wave compilation series sits close to the in-house label's core competence and serves the firm's collector base, and stable industry growth leaves no performance gap that would prompt search for alternative uses of the resources.
